name: Fruit preserves
summary: The fruit preserves Da Lat is known for, sold around the central market.
origin: Vietnam Tourism calls them Da Lat’s famous preserved fruits. The Vietnamese Wikipedia city article names mứt trái cây with the wine and the artichoke tea.
howToEat: Buy a jar at the market. Strawberry jam is the one a rural-tourism desk names in the mouth. Other fruits in the jars were not listed. Check on arrival.
where: Shops on the fringe of Da Lat Market. Early morning is the hour Vietnam Tourism gives for the market walk. A stall number is Check on arrival.
